Game Overview

In Catch The Thief, the core idea is straightforward: navigate intricate puzzles where you guide a police officer across wooden platforms to outsmart a wily thief. Each level presents fresh challenges, pushing your strategic thinking and patience. Plan carefully—any slip could mean restarting! Experience the rush of matching wits in this captivating brain-teaser adventure.
